about: Hand-kept dispersed-camping closures and rules for the best-known places where the rule decides the answer (docs/use-cases.md UC13, AUDIT R14). No national machine-readable source exists. Each entry's url was fetched and read on `checked`; bbox is a rough box around the area the order or page describes, not its legal boundary. Recheck an entry by its `expires` date.

rules.place: West of Sedona (Loy Butte Road and Boynton Canyon area)
rules.manager: Coconino National Forest, Red Rock Ranger District
rules.rule: No camping or campfires except in the designated camping areas the order lists

rules.place: South of Sedona and Oak Creek Canyon
rules.manager: Coconino National Forest, Red Rock Ranger District
rules.rule: No camping year-round except in the developed campgrounds (Pine Flat, Cave Springs, Manzanita, Chavez group)

rules.manager: Bureau of Land Management, Moab Field Office
rules.rule: Many areas near Moab and its developed campgrounds are closed to dispersed camping: camp in a campground or at a posted designated site (a tent symbol on a brown post); dispersed camping only outside those zones

rules.manager: Lake Tahoe Basin Management Unit (US Forest Service)
rules.rule: Dispersed camping, including sleeping in a vehicle, is prohibited; camp only in the areas the order lists

rules.manager: Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests, Gunnison Ranger District
rules.rule: Camp only in the Cement Creek, Lake Irwin or Gothic campgrounds or at a numbered designated site (a post with the site number and camping symbol)
